preregistered.name: R1/PDH breakout with VWAP + EMA context
preregistered.counting_starts: first NSE session after 2026-10-16 (2026-10-19); nothing before is counted
preregistered.derived_from: C001 optional filter r1_pdh_break, applied to all sessions

definition.sessions: every NSE session (no CPR / pivot setup filter)
definition.signal: first 5m bar whose close satisfies ALL: futures close > futures session VWAP; spot close > 5m EMA20, 5m EMA50, 5m EMA200 and 1m EMA200; spot close > max(daily Traditional R1, PDH)
definition.exit: first 5m CLOSE below the 5m EMA20 at or after the entry bar -> next 5m bar open; wicks do not count; force exit at the 15:20 bar open
definition.levels: R1 = 2P - L and PDH from the previous session (spot 09:15-15:29)
definition.option_traded: 1 lot (65) NIFTY CE, strike = entry spot rounded to nearest 50, nearest weekly expiry on/after the trade date
definition.option_price: real lastPrice from option_chain_snapshots.db at the first snapshot at/after each fill (max 10 min lag); modelled price reported alongside
definition.costs: nse_cost_model.NseCostModel, trade-date STT, plus 1 point premium slippage per side

preregistered.frozen_after_approval: definition, costs and bar may not change once approved; any change = a new rule id with its own fresh forward window
preregistered.approval: User approved 2026-10-16: forward pass/fail bar exactly as proposed; definition frozen; paper mode only; research_only stays true; signal_engine.py untouched.
preregistered.fingerprint_note: Re-fingerprinted 2026-10-16 when backtest statistics were moved out of forward_bar under the storage rule; definition, engine_mapping and every pass/fail threshold are unchanged.

hypotheses.description: Open-location filter on R001's signal: session open above daily CPR, below daily Camarilla H3, below weekly Camarilla H3.
hypotheses.instruction: Do NOT promote. No forward trades counted, no further tests run on it. Revisit only with the user's explicit decision.

storage_policy: rules.json stores ONLY rule fields plus dates: 'date' = the trade date the item describes (revisit that session later), 'added' / 'proposed_on' / 'approved_on' = when it was logged. No prices, candles, indicator values, levels-crossed lists, trade logs or backtest results; those are pulled from the date at run time or written only to results/ and results/history/.
